units.summary: The discovered aggregate backend's ReverseProxy now sets FlushInterval to -1, so every write is flushed to the client at once. Watch events are no longer buffered whatever Content-Length the backend sends.
units.headline: Aggregate backend proxy now flushes after every write
units.reason: One-field change to proxy flushing that only affects when streamed bytes reach the client; low risk and matches the PR's stated intent.

units.summary: The forward backend's ReverseProxy now sets FlushInterval to -1, so it flushes after every write. Watch events reach clients immediately even when the response carries a Content-Length.
units.headline: Forward backend proxy now flushes after every write
units.reason: One-field change to proxy flushing that only affects when streamed bytes reach the client; low risk.

units.summary: Adds a constant of -1 used as ReverseProxy.FlushInterval by the forward, aggregate and single-tenant proxies. It is only a definition; the effect comes from the three call sites.
units.headline: Add streamingFlushInterval constant (-1) for proxies
units.reason: A new constant whose only effect is through the call sites, which are shown in the other units.

units.summary: The breakers cache now holds *groupBreaker (a two-step gobreaker) instead of the one-step circuit breaker. This is type plumbing for the new breaker accounting in breaker.go.
units.headline: ST fallback breaker cache now holds two-step breakers
units.reason: A type-only change on a field; breaker behavior lives in breaker.go and is reviewed there.

units.summary: The breaker LRU cache is constructed with the *groupBreaker value type, matching the struct field change.
units.headline: ST fallback breaker cache constructed with groupBreaker type
units.reason: Type-parameter change only, forced by the field type change.

units.summary: The single-tenant fallback's ReverseProxy now sets FlushInterval to -1 so watch events flush after each write. The other lines are gofmt alignment.
units.headline: ST fallback proxy now flushes after every write
units.reason: One-field change to proxy flushing that only affects when streamed bytes reach the client.

units.summary: The return type changes to *groupBreaker. The key construction and cache logic are unchanged.
units.headline: ST breakerForDestination returns groupBreaker type
units.reason: Signature type change only, following the two-step breaker switch.
